lead.headline: Early risers wanted: next cohort begins {nextMonday}
lead.deck: A 21-day live programme is looking for students, professionals and founders ready to own their mornings. Sessions start at 6:00 AM sharp.

columns.title: What you get
columns.text: Twenty-one live 6 AM sessions on Zoom, the S.A.V.E.R.S routine, daily accountability and a private Skool community that notices when you show up.

columns.title: Who it's for
columns.text: Anyone aged 12 and above. Students preparing for exams, professionals stuck in a rut, and founders who want their mornings back.

columns.title: How to join
columns.text: Pick your plan, fill in the coupon below, and you'll be taken to Razorpay to pay securely. Your Skool invite follows by email.
